verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never names official iOS or Android apps. The only related line, cross-platform sync of conversations and settings "across every platform" (grok-docs-41), does not say which platforms exist or whether mobile apps are full-featured. The community mention of building an iOS app with Grok concerns code generation, not a Grok mobile app.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android
